Focus.title: Focus
Focus.subtitle: Flexible sessions for studying, practising or working with calm.

active.conflictHint: Finish or continue the active session before starting another.

empty.title: Start your first Focus session
empty.body: Focus helps you concentrate at your own pace: a countdown, a free stopwatch, or work-and-break cycles. No pressure and no opaque scores.
empty.offlineHint: If you are offline, you can still continue a session you already started — starting a new one needs a connection.

onboarding.title: What is Focus?
onboarding.body: Flexible concentration sessions for study, work or practice — at your pace, without guilt or opaque scores.

points.modes: Three modes: countdown, free stopwatch, or work/break cycles.
points.tasks: Optional link to a task or habit — finishing never auto-completes work unless you choose it.
points.privacy: Notes and distractions stay private and only live in your account export.
points.recovery: Timers recover after reload; delivery of alerts depends on the browser when the app is fully closed.

onboarding.pathsHint: Pick a path — you can change everything later.
onboarding.suggestionsHint: Editable examples (not categories — you keep control):

autoStart.label: About auto-start
autoStart.body: Auto-start moves to the next phase when a timed block ends. You can still pause, skip or finish manually. Off by default for focus after breaks if you prefer a deliberate restart.

wakeLock.label: About keeping the screen awake
wakeLock.body: Screen Wake Lock only runs while a session is active and this option is on. Some browsers deny it or release it when the tab is hidden. Focus still works without it.

notifications.label: About notifications
notifications.body: System alerts need an explicit allow. If permission is denied, in-app cues and sound (when enabled) still work while Planora is open. Fully closed PWAs may not receive alerts.

completeTask.label: About completing a task
completeTask.body: Finishing a Focus session never marks a task done unless you opt in for that session. Habits may ask for a confirmation when the occurrence is ambiguous.

structuredPlan.label: About structured plans
structuredPlan.body: Optional ordered blocks (timed or open). You can skip forward; going back is not allowed so history stays honest. Starter ideas for programming, English and piano are fully editable.

sync.label: About tabs and devices
sync.body: One active session per account. Other tabs become view-only until you choose Continue here. Offline you can keep a known session going; starting a new one needs a network connection.

presets.deleteDescription: Past sessions keep their configuration snapshot. The preset itself will be removed.

export.title: Export data

json.title: Full backup

csv.description: Spreadsheet tables for analysis. Focus notes and distractions are omitted from the main session CSV and only appear in a separate PRIVATE notes file when present. Focus is not added to calendar ICS.

ics.title: Calendar
ics.description: Export your events and tasks for use in other calendar applications. Focus sessions are not included.
